09e684c6275ce61b.test_split: not run on this definition. One test-split ticket ran once on 2026-11-15 as a regression check and passed; that is not a test-split score. The full validation rerun of 2026-11-18 had 4 infrastructure errors, so the test split was not started
09e684c6275ce61b.caveat: Every result file is kept outside the repository because it holds each reply and response ID. The 2026-11-18 run saved its JSON but not its full printed score sheet, so the four replies were scored again offline with the repository's own scorers; the verdicts matched. The JSON does not record the definition hash: the runner printed it and refuses to run unless the published definition matches main's, and main at 18190c5 builds 09e684c6275ce61b. The four-ticket run's per-ticket trace was retrieved afterward, on 2026-11-18, by read-only Foundry retrieval of its saved response IDs (no model call): ~/fwagent-runs/2026-11-18-v17-RITM0011072-0075.trace.jsonl.
